scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run start:server" "npm run start:web"
scripts.build:desktop:all: npm run build:desktop:renderer && npm run build:desktop:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop:all && npm run dist --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.release:desktop: npm run build:desktop:all && npm run release --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && cross-env NOCTAS_DESKTOP_MANAGE_WEB=1 npm run start --workspace=apps/desktop
